# Three Dividend-paying Motorsports Stocks Offer Intrigue


By:[Paul Dykewicz](https://www.dividendinvestor.com/author/pdykewicz-admin/)


, August 28, 2026


Link copied!


Three dividend-paying motorsports stocks offer intrigue and potential excitement for investors.


The three motorsports stocks worth tracking are liked by Jim Woods, an investment professional who follows racing closely and also teaches how to drive sports cars on banked tracks safely. Woods, who heads the[Forecasts & Strategies](https://jimwoodsinvesting.stockinvestor.com/offer/fs-web-default-2/?source=GURUFS) investment newsletter and four specialized advisory services, attends the Long Beach Grand Prix each year that he is able to do so and told me he favors three motorsports stocks in particular.


None of the three are current picks in his newsletter or[TNT Trader](https://jimwoodsinvesting.stockinvestor.com/offer/tnt-trader-web-default-2/?source=GURUTNT) ,[Tactical Trader](https://jimwoodsinvesting.stockinvestor.com/offer/tactical-trader-web-default-offer/?source=GURUTT01) *,*[Five Star Trader](https://jimwoodsinvesting.stockinvestor.com/offer/five-star-trader-web-default-2/?source=GURUFST) and[Bullseye Stock Trader](https://jimwoodsinvesting.stockinvestor.com/offer/bullseye-default/?source=GURUBEST1) advisory services that recommend both stocks and options, but he monitors positive news that can lift investments. Good motorsports publicity came from the Freedom 250, an IndyCar street race that took place on Sunday, Aug. 23, in Washington, D.C.


*Jim Woods heads[Forecasts & Strategies](https://jimwoodsinvesting.stockinvestor.com/offer/fs-web-default-2/?source=GURUFS) and teaches race track driving.*


Supported and attended by President Trump and other government leaders in Washington, the race was nationally televised in the United States by Fox, and the race course passed national landmarks. The buildings included the U.S. Capitol, the Department of Justice, the National Archives, the National Gallery of Art and Smithsonian Institution’s Air and Space Museum.


Mario Andretti, a former championship racer, described it as a “privilege” to witness the historic, first-ever NTT IndyCar Series race on the streets of Washington, D.C. Andretti further said that he envied the drivers competing in the race that included going past iconic buildings. The Andretti Global racing team had three drivers in the race who finished among the top four, including 27-year-old American Kyle Kirkwood, who won the Freedom 250.


*Pennsylvania Ave. became FreedomFest 250’s pit lane and main straightaway.*


**Three Dividend-paying Motorsports Stocks: Polaris**


Polaris Inc. (NYSE: PII) is a Medina, Minnesota-based manufacturer of motorsports, powersports and outdoor recreation vehicles. Its product line includes snowmobiles, boats, all-terrain vehicles (ATVs) and side-by-sides (SxS) and utility task vehicles (UTVs).


The four main side-by-side (SxS) and utility task vehicles (UTVs) are categorized by whether they are built for heavy-duty work, high-speed sport or adventure-travel. Even though none of those vehicles are suitable to Freedom 250 Champion Kyle Kirkwood to win his IndyCar race, they offer a chance for exhilarating experiences.


I asked investment professional and thrill-seeking adventurer Jim Woods, who heads the *[Forecasts & Strategies](https://jimwoodsinvesting.stockinvestor.com/offer/fs-web-default-2/?source=GURUFS)* newsletter, what Polaris vehicle he likes best, and he named the RZR, pronounced “razor.”


Advertisement.


“The Polaris RZR is the ultimate form of four-wheel off-road fun,” Woods said. “It’s a perfect blend of power and agility is guaranteed to put a smile on everyone’s face. It’s no surprise that the RZR is one of the most-popular UTVs in the market today.”


*Jim Woods is rated as the No. 1 stock blogger by Tip Ranks.*


Despite “strong” results in the second quarter and a “massive” though refund-aided capital raise, PII shares sold off on the news due to conservative second-half guidance by its management. The guidance addressed an “uncertain macro environment” and flattish retail assumption, Citi Research wrote.


Facing a difficult retail comparison in third quarter 2026, Polaris management concluded the “conservatism” is wise, Citi Research continued. Long-term, although investors may be wary of risks, the company has done “a great deal” to optimize the portfolio and maximize supply chain flexibility, it continued.


With that backdrop, Citi Research boosted its price target for Polaris up from $70 to $73, while rating it as neutral. Income investors may like that Polaris also offers a dividend yield of 4.62%.


One intriguing develop is that some sizable financial companies recently filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) to seek the purchase of a significant number of shares in Polaris. With the company also looking into data center opportunities, this company could be worth tracking for more than just its traditional product line in vehicles that can give the users thrills and sometimes even spills.


*Chart courtesy of[www.stockcharts.com](http://www.stockcharts.com/) .*


**Three Dividend-paying Motorsports Stocks: Penske**


IndyCars were the ones racing at the Freedom 250, spearheaded by Roger Penske, the founder of Penske Automotive Group, Inc., (NYSE: PAG), headquartered in Bloomfield Hills, Michigan. Penske himself could be described as a living legend in my home state of Michigan for many decades involved with championship racing, as well as the leadership of global transportation company from a suburb of Detroit.


*Pennsylvania Ave. in Washington, D.C., became pit row at the Freedom 250.*


Penske Automotive Group, Inc. is a diversified international transportation services company and one of the world’s largest automotive and commercial truck retailers. PAG operates dealerships in the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, Germany, Italy, Japan and Australia, and is one of the largest retailers of commercial trucks in North America for Freightliner.


PAG also distributes and retails commercial vehicles, diesel and gas engines, power systems and related parts and services principally in Australia and New Zealand. The company employs more than 28,900 people worldwide.


Additionally, Penske Automotive owns 28.9% of Penske Transportation Solutions, a business that employs more than 44,500 people worldwide, manages one of the largest and most comprehensive trucking fleets in North America, offering more than 435,000 trucks, tractors and trailers under lease, rental and/or maintenance contracts and providing transportation, supply chain and technology solutions to its customers.


Advertisement.


“About 71% of the dealer’s brand mix consists of premium luxury names such as BMW, Porsche, Mercedes-Benz and Audi, which provide stronger profit margins and customers who are less sensitive to economic downturns,” Woods told me. “Plus, Roger Penske is the very best owner in motorsports, and is one of the powers behind creating the Freedom 250.”


However, Penske Corporation announced on July 22, 2026, that it and its Japanese partner, Mitsui & Co., submitted a $3.8 billion all-cash proposal, valued at $210 per share, to buy out the remaining 27.8% publicly held stake in[Penske Automotive Group](https://investors.penskeautomotive.com/news/news-details/2026/PENSKE-AUTOMOTIVE-GROUP-CONFIRMS-RECEIPT-OF-UNSOLICITED-PRELIMINARY-AND-NON-BINDING-TAKE-PRIVATE-PROPOSAL/default.aspx) and take the major retailer private. For investors, Penske Automotive now is in watch mode, since it closed Monday, Aug. 25, at $217.01, $7.01 per share above the proposed purpose price.


An open question is whether investors expect the prospective buyers to raise their bid or if Penske is such a hot brand that people are buying the shares of PAG without knowing the company’s plans to go private at a lower than where the shares currently trade. With a respectable dividend yield of 2.65%, Penske Automotive Group also may appeal to income investors.


Cars owned and prepared by Team Penske have produced more than 640 race wins, nearly 700 pole positions and 47 championships across open-wheel, stock car and sports car racing competition. During Team Penske’s 59-year history, it has earned 20 Indianapolis 500 victories, three Daytona 500 Championships, a Formula 1 win and victories in the 24 Hours of Daytona and the 12 Hours of Sebring, along with a victory in Australia’s legendary Bathurst 1000 race. Team Penske currently competes in the NTT INDYCAR SERIES and the NASCAR Cup Series.


*Chart courtesy of[www.stockcharts.com](http://www.stockcharts.com/) .*


**Three Dividend-paying Motorsports Stocks: Ferrari**


Ferrari NV (NYSE: RACE), of Maranello, Italy, has a unique position among automobile manufacturers. It seeks to connect its vehicles with customers through three key traits: performance, design and emotion, according to Citi Research.


In addition to investing resources in state-of-the-art engines, Ferrari’s research and development (R&D) is focused on the continued improvement of vehicles through innovation in aerodynamics, processes, materials and weight reduction. Citi Research described the connection between the Ferrari brand and the customer base as a way to deliver “economic value” to shareholders.


Ferrari has been trying to cultivate that relationship by spacing out its product cycle with about 15 new models between 2023 and 2026, controlled production volumes, managing the pre-owned vehicle sales channel and creating exclusivity around its iconic brand with Ferrari clubs.


“The luxury exotic car market is exploding with millionaire and billionaire buyers collecting exotics the way kids collect baseball cards,” Woods told me.


As one of the most prestigious sports car companies in the world, Ferrari has an average rating of “overweight” with a consensus price target from 28 analysts of $459.39, according to FactSet. The Consensus Price Target is $459.39 USD (calculated across 28 tracking analysts. The average is moderate Buy and strong buy ratings).


*Chart courtesy of[www.stockcharts.com](http://www.stockcharts.com/) .*


Advertisement.


My Publisher, Roger Michalski, and I once visited a Ferrari store during a work trip and were impressed with the items on display. In fact, he once obtained some Ferrari caps and gave them out due to their “wow” factor.


*Roger Michalski and Paul Dykewicz attend the Freedom 250 in Washington, D.C.*


After the Freedom 250, I was asked about my experience as a fan at the race by NBC4 in Washington, D.C. I shared my views in a brief interview. To watch, please[click here](https://www.nbcwashington.com/video/news/local/cleanup-underway-and-some-roads-reopen-after-dc-indycar-race/4145579/) .


*Here is a Ferrari cap that shows the company’s prancing stallion logo.*


**Three Dividend-paying Motorsports Stocks: Geopolitical Update**


With military action taking place in multiple places in the world and global geopolitical risk still a big concern, these three investments offer a potentially profitable path forward to receive income and share-price appreciation amid the chaos. The Freedom 250 was well-received by racing fans in Washington nonetheless, based on my observations while attending the event.


Investors willing to trade options also can try an advisory service that teaches them how to do so. A pure play options service that trades into volatility to pursue quick profits is DayTradeSPY, advised Hugh Grossman, who heads the service. In fact, the[DayTradeSPY Trading Room](https://daytradespy.com/offer/trading-room-default-editorial/?source=GURUTR1) has a win rate that averages 89.8%, its[Pick of the Day](https://daytradespy.com/offer/pick-of-the-day-default/?source=GURUPOD1) service track record is 88.6%, and the[DayTradeSPY Signal](https://daytradespy.com/offer/daytradespy-signal-default/?source=DTSSIGGURU) service produces profits 86% of the time.


As long as there is turmoil in the world… wars, tariffs, political upheaval, you name it, “we make money,” said Grossman.


“We can’t control the events of the day, but we can take advantage of that instability by trading short-term movements,” Grossman commented. “Options on SPY provide outstanding leverage and liquidity for quick profits.”
